title: 2.8.2.2 Dev : can't restart loop if stopped
body:
In 2.8.2 main, I can stop and restart the loop from the main page. In 2.8.2.2 dev, if I stop the loop, I need to go in the settings to reactivate the loop option.
When it is activated, I have a very strange 364days (deactivated ?) under the button.

comments.body:
Follow-up. It seems that from the user interface, I can only "downgrade" loop functions but not "upgrade". If I select _open loop_, then I can NOT select _closed loop_ from the main page. I need to go to the settings to activate closed loop. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/130218240-2ace68ec-e424-40ca-a446-d6d4a58547a3.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/130218254-44a36cd6-d26b-4e5c-85b4-b5c91cbdf2d2.png)

You can also select Low Glucose Suspend.  Then click the loop icon again to select Closed Loop.
Not correct, but slightly easier than going to settings!

Nice try but no, it doesn't work of you turn off the loop. ;)

I never turn off the loop but I'm in testing stuff mode so I hit all the buttons available  :)

I made a PR to fix bug of disable loop (#634)... And this issue is partially included in #630.
Concerning the direct switch from open loop to closed loop,  I have to look into constraints (closed loop is currently not aloud from open loop, even if relative objectives are passed...)

I also prepared a commit (not currently pushed in the PR) to improve a bit user interface when loop is suspended or pump disconnected:
It will be possible to resume (respectively reconnect pump), or select a new duration.
My computer is off for 3 days, I'll update PR when I'll back home, but you can test current proposal and add comment if necessary...
That works for me. I can disconnect and reconnect my pump. In addition I can see that I'm now able to extend the disconnection time while I'm already disconnected. This is awesome!

Hi Milos. It is partially solved. I can select "open loop" and come back to "closed loop" but I cannot stop the loop and then restart it from the main UI. Once the loop is stopped, I need to go in the config generator in order to reactivate the loop. I don't know if this is a bug or a feature ;)
Robert
